summary: Example CLI task runs show version on EXOS with community.network.exos_command.
questions: How do I get the EXOS version with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Get EXOS version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve EXOS OS version
  community.network.exos_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.exos'
```
